hooks.command: python3 -I -B -c "import hashlib, os, runpy, sys, tempfile;from pathlib import Path;package_root = Path(sys.argv[1]);package_digest = sys.argv[2];configured_snapshots = os.environ.get('TJ_AGENTS_STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY', '');plugin_data = Path(os.environ.get('PLUGIN_DATA', '')).resolve();snapshots = Path(configured_snapshots) if configured_snapshots else plugin_data / 'hook-snapshots';snapshot_key = hashlib.sha256((str(package_root) + chr(0) + package_digest).encode()).hexdigest();loaders = (base / 'hooks' / 'codex' / 'snapshot.py' for base in (snapshots / snapshot_key, package_root));newline = chr(10).encode();sources = (loader.read_bytes().replace(chr(13).encode() + newline, newline).replace(chr(13).encode(), newline) for loader in loaders if loader.is_file());source = next((candidate for candidate in sources if hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest() == '6b0a93813cd3cbf9e79445563ea738e48870fe8a41ab15cfd640d6e3ea03c6f9'), None);source is not None or (sys.stderr.write('Codex hook snapshot loader integrity check failed' + chr(10)), sys.exit(2));workspace = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();staged = Path(workspace.name) / 'loader.py';staged.write_bytes(source);runpy.run_path(str(staged), run_name='__main__')" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "sha256:a88c875d72c7f2c3fc8f3f1897138ae5c21c5f3c480ff2cfbce97ef4e353329f" "base" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/tier_gate.py" --session-context
